channel.title: DevPulse · Research
channel.description: Daily research stories worth an engineer's time.

item.title: BeyondSCe uses event history and active views to grasp occluded targets
item.description: The zero-shot robot system combines interaction history with scene geometry to identify grasp targets and choose camera views; reported success reaches 77% for initially occluded targets versus a 55% baseline. Its results show how memory and active sensing can work together in embodied systems.

item.title: A proof-difficulty metric steers LLMs toward less-overlapping mathematical theorems
item.description: The work trains a 27B model to predict proof difficulty and reports reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%. Its metric offers a concrete approach to selecting outputs for generative research systems.
